QuestInfo.name: [Operation: Dive] Han the Broker's Info
QuestInfo.0: Defeat the chimeras, then speak with the person who called out to you.
QuestInfo.1: Han the Broker offers up some information, free of charge. That's unusual for him... However, this is a good opportunity to learn about what's going in this Magatia.
QuestInfo.2: Han the Broker told you about what's been happening in Magatia. Take the report he gave you to the Zenumist and Alcadno Societies.
